description: qualys CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record): the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that qualys is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure, pinned to released tags: computing_core (packages), compliance_core (the neutral finding and vulnerability record) and aws_core, which qualys declares optional (the EC2 instance it links to; req-qualys-ec2-link) and which validate_plugin --strict requires the record to install. The consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population is empty: no step seeds data. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5).
